days.title: Meet .NET + Git

dotnet new / run / build, the .csproj file
Console input and output, int.Parse, integer division

learned: int, double, decimal, bool, char, string
Why decimal for money (0.1 + 0.2)
var, const, casting cuts
Parse crashes, TryParse refuses safely

days.title: if / else
learned: Comparison and logical operators
First match wins in an if-else chain
Guard clauses with return
Scope: declare before the block

days.title: switch + Git undo
learned: switch statement: case, break, stacked cases
switch expression: =>, or, >= patterns, _
CS0163, CS8510, CS8509 and a runtime crash
Commit messages, amend, restore, revert

days.title: while loops + Random
learned: while loop: check first, zero iterations
Infinite loop from a stray ; (CS0642), Ctrl+C
Random.Shared.Next(min, max): the max is excluded
Sentinel loop and the off-by-one error

days.title: Project 01: Number Guessing Game
learned: Input validation loop: TryParse + nested if
A line above the loop runs once, inside runs every time
Test with a hard-coded secret, test every path
Meaningful names (F2), formatting, an honest README
Git: pathspec errors, git add ., ahead of origin, push

days.title: Git cleanup + the for loop
learned: Git: diff, restore, restore --staged, atomic commits, --amend, push
for loop: initializer, condition, iterator
The body runs before the iterator; N iterations = N + 1 checks
Accumulator: declare before, update inside, print after
Guard clause: ! + early return

days.title: do-while, break and continue
learned: Git: the staging area is a basket (order doesn't matter), clean it before --amend
do-while: post-test loop, runs at least once, ; required
Declare before do so the condition can see it (CS0103)
bool flag: ok = int.TryParse(...), name it honestly
break leaves the loop, continue skips one iteration
built: Day 7 committed in 3 atomic commits + pushed
Times Table v2: ask until valid (3 tests pass)

days.title: Guessing Game v1.1: %, ||, guard clauses
learned: % is the remainder, not percent: 7 % 3 = 1
|| needs one true, && needs both; > excludes the edge
Guard clauses with continue keep the loop body flat
A break gives the loop a second exit: check the exit reason
CS0162: unreachable code after break
built: Project 01 v1.1: range check, guard clauses, q to quit (pushed)

days.title: Calculator v1, arrays and foreach
learned: int ÷ int cuts off decimals; double keeps them
double.TryParse, and double / 0 gives ∞ instead of crashing
switch on a string: exact match, one case runs
Operator guard: != joined with && (|| rejects everything)
Arrays: index 0 to Length - 1, IndexOutOfRangeException
foreach + accumulator + counter, results printed after the loop
built: LinkedIn post 01 (live) + resume Experience + new headline

days.title: List<T> and methods part 1
learned: The last index is Length - 1 (zero-based)
List<T>: Add, Remove, Count, [0], foreach; it can grow
A method is defined once and called many times; each call runs the whole body
void gives nothing back; a return type + return sends a value back
Parameters are filled by arguments in the same order; use the parameter name inside
One method, one job: calculate in one, print in another
